probeMethod: cold plain-HTTP axios, iPhone Safari UA (iOS 17_2), 1.8s inter-request spacing, NO Playwright, NO warmup, NO cookies; STOP-on-escalation guard armed on every request (202/403/429/503 + SG-Captcha header + .well-known/sgcaptcha body + sgcaptcha meta-refresh)
probeBudget: 19 requests across 2 sequential runs (7 + 12). 0 escalations. Did not exceed ~15-per-run careful-pace constraint per run.

evidence: Run 1 (cold, no warmup): 7/7 clean HTTP 200, zero challenge markers — /, /product-category/firearms/, /product-category/parts/, Store API count, WP REST count, 2 detail pages. All at 1.8s spacing.

Run 2 (deeper sustained walk, still cold): 12/12 clean HTTP 200, zero challenge markers — 6 category pages incl. /page/2/ and /page/3/ pagination, /page/9/ boundary, WP REST newest-10, Store API per_page=10 + page=2, search ?s=ruger. No mid-walk re-challenge, no escalation.
Combined: 19/19 cold iPhone-UA requests clean. sgcaptcha did NOT re-challenge at sustained ~1.8s pace. No SG-Captcha header, no 202, no .well-known/sgcaptcha redirect on any request.

Detail page (ruger-10-22 bolt assembly) returns JSON-LD @type=Product, availability=schema.org/InStock, price=119.99, in-stock CSS class, add-to-cart present — restock/OOS detection via verifyMethod=detail-page is fully viable.
Production baseBudget=1800 (ledger bump 2026-06-02) enforces effective gap >=2s, which is SLOWER than the 1.8s pace tested here — so production pace is at least as safe as the probe.
Server header nginx; SiteGround SG-F-Cache/X-Proxy-Cache in front. No Akamai/Imperva-style hard product-page block (contrast basspro/hical).
reachabilityVerdict.caveat: sgcaptcha is a real SiteGround layer and IS burst-sensitive: prior B4R3 (2026-05-19, 99.228.63.11) observed 5/6 Store API calls returning 202 after a per_page=100 bulk dump with NO inter-request gap. The bypass holds ONLY at paced iPhone-UA HTTP (>=1.5s). Recommendation: keep needsPlaywright=true as the cookie-cache SAFETY NET (DB wafWorkaround.method=cookie-cache, storeApiAvailable=true, 30min TTL) so a stray 202/403 triggers a Playwright re-solve rather than a failure cascade — but the steady-state path is plain HTTP, no Playwright per request. Do NOT issue burst/no-gap requests and do NOT request per_page=100 bulk dumps; cap perPage and keep the inter-request delay.
reachabilityVerdict.probeIp: audit-IP (not production crawler IP) — production IP behavior should match since the gate is UA + pace based, not IP-reputation based; the desktop-UA 403 is UA-driven (Mistake 30).

notes: PRIMARY RESULT: iPhone-UA cold plain-HTTP bypass HOLDS at sustained 1.8s pace across 19 requests with zero sgcaptcha challenge. This contradicts B4R3's burst-202 observation, which was caused by no-gap bursts + per_page=100 bulk dump, not by the paced path. The gate is UA + pace, not request-count.
DB notes ('iPhone mobile UA bypasses cleanly via plain HTTP — no Playwright needed') are corroborated by live evidence; the wafWorkaround cookie-cache is the fallback, not the primary path.
wafType=sgcaptcha is correct (SiteGround SG-F-Cache/X-Proxy-Cache present; desktop UA returns 403 per Mistake 30). hasWaf=true correct. Keep as-is.
Do NOT run heavy 8-batch / rapid-burst probes against this site (IP-ban + 202-cascade risk). The reachability question is answered without them.

Operational guardrails for enable: (1) keep userAgentOverride = iPhone iOS 17_2 UA; (2) keep inter-request delay >=1.5s (baseBudget=1800 already enforces ~2s); (3) cap perPage (12 HTML / <=20 Store API) — NO per_page=100; (4) leave Playwright cookie-cache fallback armed for 202/403 recovery.
